book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: HEBREOS Hebreos're queti owa cojorica pũuro

content: Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ Macʉ̃ menapʉ wedeupi
Tĩrʉmʉpʉre mani ñicʉ̃ jãare paʉ tiiri, ñucã bojorica wãmeri wado, cʉ̃ yee quetire wede jʉgueri maja mena wedeupi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ.
Ati rʉmʉri ca tʉjari rʉmʉripʉra, cʉ̃ Macʉ̃ mena manire wedeupi. Cʉ̃rena niipetirije ca cʉo nʉnʉjeepʉ cʉ̃re cũu, ñucã cʉ̃ jʉorira ati ʉmʉrecore jeeño, tiiupi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ.

Cʉ̃ra niimi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ do biro ca tiiya manigʉ cʉ̃ ca niirijere ca boe bate niigʉ, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca baurijera nii, cʉ̃ ca wede tutuarije menara niipetirijere tuu ñee, ca tiigʉ. Mani ca ñañarije wapare coe yapanori jiro,
Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca duwiri tabe díámacʉ̃ nʉña pee duwi eaupi ʉmʉreco tutipʉre.
O biro biiri, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pʉto macãrã ametʉenero ca niigʉ nii ea, ñucã cʉ̃ja ametʉenero ca nii majuropeeri wãme ca cʉogʉ nii eaupi.
Jesucristo, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pʉto macãrã ametʉenero ca niigʉ
Ʉmʉreco Pacʉa jĩcãti ʉno peera jĩcʉ̃ cʉ̃ pʉto macʉ̃ ʉno peerena: “Mʉ, yʉ macʉ̃ mʉ nii. Mecʉ̃ra mʉre yʉ macʉ̃ jãa,”
cʉ̃re ĩitiupi. Ñucã jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peerena: “Yʉa cʉ̃ pacʉ yʉ niirucu. Cʉ̃ pea yʉ macʉ̃ niirucumi,” ĩitiupi cʉ̃ pʉto macãrãre.
Cʉ̃ Macʉ̃ jĩcʉ̃ra ca niigʉ ca nii majuropeegʉre ati yepapʉ cʉ̃re tiicojo cojogʉ, o biro ĩiupi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ:

content.text: “Niipetirã Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pʉto macãrã cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉojato.”
Cʉ̃re queti wede bojari maja peera, o biro ĩimi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ: “Cʉ̃re ca queti wede bojarãra winore biro cʉ̃ja ca niiro cʉ̃jare tiimi.
Ñucã cʉ̃re pade bojari majara pecamere biro cʉ̃ja ca niiro cʉ̃jare tiimi.”

content: Cʉ̃ Macʉ̃ peera o biro pee ĩiupi:

content.text: “Mʉ, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ, mʉ ca doti niirije peti nʉcãtirucu, mʉ ca doti niirijea ca niirore biro wado tiirique nii.
Añurijere mai, ñañarije peera juna, mʉ biiwʉ.
To biri Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ mʉ Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ, mʉre beje amiri, mʉ mena macãrã
“Mʉ, ‘Wiogʉ,’ jĩcãtopʉre mʉra ati yepare mʉ tiiupa. Ʉmʉreco quejeroa, mʉra mʉ ca tiiriquera nii.
Mʉ ca jeeñorique niipetirije yai nʉcã peticoarucu.
Tee niipetirije, jutiro ca boa nʉnʉa waarore biro peticã nʉnʉa waarucu.
To biro to ca biimijata cãare, mʉ pea to birora mʉ niicõa nii.
Jutirore tuupe queno cũuricarore biro teere mʉ tiirucu; apeye wãma cʉ̃ ca juti wajoarore biro teere mʉ wajoarucu.
Mʉ pea cʉ̃ra mʉ niicõa nii. Mʉ ca cati niirije peti nʉcãtirucu,” ĩiupi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ Macʉ̃re.

content: Ʉmʉreco Pacʉa, jĩcãti ʉno peera jĩcʉ̃ cʉ̃ pʉto macʉ̃ ʉno peerena:

content.text: mʉ waparãre cʉ̃ja ca doca cũmuro yʉ ca tiiropʉ,” ĩitiupi.

content: Cʉ̃ pʉto macãrã niipetirã ca bautirã niima, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre pade bojari maja ametʉariquere ca cʉo eaparãre tii nemo dotigʉ cʉ̃ ca tiicojorã.
